properties.title: Mutthornhütte SAC
properties.description:
From summer 2026, the Mutthorn Hut SAC will have a new location at the western foot of the Mutthorn. The hutis in the thick of it: ice and snow, Blüemlisalp and Petersgrat, between Kandersteg and Stechelberg, between Kiental and Lötschental. The mountain hut can only be reached by crossing glaciers - however, the approach from Stechelberg is no longer recommended due to the current risk of rockfalls from the Chanzel.
Warning: All access routes cross glaciers. Appropriate experience and equipment, or the guidance of a mountain guide, are required.
